metas.name: 1 · ★ 5.9 · 2002 · xXx
metas.description: The US government recruits extreme sports athlete Xander Cage to infiltrate a Russian criminal ring, which is plotting the destruction of the world.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 4.5 · 2005 · xXx: State of the Union
metas.description: Darius Stone, a new agent in the xXx program, is sent to Washington, D.C. to stop a coup attempt against the President of the United States.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.2 · 2017 · xXx: Return of Xander Cage
